text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein orders 90 million dinars to finance schoolchildren food distribution programme.
- Head of the foreign office of the ruling Baath Party Saad Qasim Hammoudi met a senior official of the Spanish Communist Party in Madrid.
- Iraq repatriates eight Kuwaiti children while the Kuwaiti authorities rejected to receive their mother.
- Ukraine wants to enhance economic ties with Iraq.
